description:
We are seeking an experienced and dedicated Director of Nursing (DON) to lead the clinical team at a premier skilled nursing facility in Mediapolis, IA. This pivotal leadership role offers the opportunity to shape the standard of patient care, foster a supportive environment for nursing staff, and ensure operational excellence. You will be instrumental in maintaining high-quality healthcare services and achieving positive patient outcomes.

As the Director of Nursing, you will oversee all aspects of nursing operations, including staff management, policy implementation, and adherence to regulatory standards. This role is ideal for a compassionate leader with a strong clinical background who is committed to enhancing the lives of residents and empowering a team of healthcare professionals. Join a facility dedicated to providing exceptional care and a rewarding work environment.
requirements: Active Registered Nurse (RN) license in the state of Iowa
Minimum of 2-3 years of experience in a nursing leadership role, such as DON or ADON
Prior experience within a skilled nursing facility or long-term care setting
Demonstrated ability to manage nursing operations, staff, and ensure regulatory compliance
Strong clinical assessment, critical thinking, and communication skills
salaryOrBonusInfo: Annual salary range of $85,000 - $95,000, commensurate with experience.
